description: Verify that the numbers in a finished table add up — before you deliver it. Use this when you have produced or received a table, spreadsheet, CSV/TSV or markdown table, a cost breakdown, invoice, quotation or budget, and need an independent check that row totals, column totals and subtotals are arithmetically consistent, or that a list of line items sums to a stated total. Returns every mismatched cell with the recomputed value and the difference, plus a signed verification receipt (verification ID, UTC time, SHA-256 content hash, and a public verification URL that anyone can use to confirm the check happened). Checks arithmetic consistency only; does not verify source data. Accepts common international formats: accounting negatives in parentheses, currency symbols, semicolon-delimited tables with decimal commas, and percent values. Tables may include formulas: supported formulas are evaluated for the arithmetic check, and every formula is audited for pattern deviations, hardcoded values among formulas and broken references, returned as advisory findings. Every result states its coverage — how many checks ran, the tolerance applied (0.005), and which numeric columns or formulas could not be checked — so a MATCH certifies only the totals that were located and recomputed. It audits finished numbers; it does not build new calculations for you.

content.description: The finished table (markdown, CSV or TSV) or the "name: value" breakdown text to audit.

name: verify_numbers
title: Verify numbers in a finished table or breakdown
